name: Maximilian Huber
bio:
Maximilian's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for planes, which quickly evolved into an obsession with the aerodynamics of race cars. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Graz University of Technology, specializing in fluid dynamics. After graduating, he interned at a smaller F3 team, where he quickly rose through the ranks, contributing to significant improvements in their car's downforce. 

His relentless pursuit of perfection and deep understanding of airflow management caught the eye of Blau Motorsport. As Head of Aero, Maximilian is known for his methodical approach and his ability to translate complex simulations into tangible on-track performance. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and innovative problem-solving. His mentoring approach has already helped several junior engineers excel.

Maximilian's distinctive ability lies in his intuition for understanding how seemingly small aerodynamic adjustments can have a significant impact on overall performance. He is driven to push the boundaries of what's aerodynamically possible, and is known for his intense focus and long hours in the wind tunnel.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Maximilian is a slender man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having the wind tunnel temperature set to exactly 22 degrees Celsius.
